purpose: Establish the immutable financial charge facts required by payment allocation and attendance reconciliation.
success_outcome: Charges snapshot the applicable historical price, retain exact values, and support deterministic correction/replay with audit evidence.
anti_goals: Do not rewrite historical charges after a price setting changes.
Do not let consumers write financial tables.
constraints: Use exact monetary representation and transactional persistence.
Financial Ledger owns charge, price, and audit state.
invariants: Replay produces the same financial facts for the same input sequence.
verification_targets: FT-006-AC-001: before/after price-setting integration with exact-value charge persistence and future-charge-only effect.
FT-006-AC-004: isolated attendance/charge correction replay and audit scenario proving deterministic allocation/balance and author/time/change facts.

stop_conditions: Stop if monetary exactness or storage source of truth requires a global architecture change.
